Part of [N: Nervous system](../).

The main indication for these drugs is covered in the [schizophrenia primer](/docs/pathology-primers/neurological/schizophrenia/).

**Dropout is informative.**
Dropout probability rises with a high observed PANSS score, so the dropout hazard is modeled jointly with the score as a [time-to-event](/docs/modeling/tte/) process [@pillareddyModellingSimulationPositive2012].
Ignoring it biases parameter estimates, though simulation put that bias relatively low; the model matters most for realistic trial simulation [@bjornsson2015dropout].
